description: Capture a screenshot of the current screen on the Roku device. A sideloaded dev channel must be running. Returns the image as base64-encoded content and the file path where it was saved.

host.description: IP address or hostname of the Roku device

outDir.description: Directory to save the screenshot. Defaults to OS temp directory.

outFile.description: Base filename (without extension). Defaults to timestamped name.

password.description: Developer password for the Roku device

name: roku_screenshot
